from os import symlink
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

NOTES_DIR: Path = Path("notes")


def _resolve_note(name: str) -> Path | None:
    """Return the resolved path for `name` under NOTES_DIR, or None if it escapes NOTES_DIR.

    Absolute names, names containing `..` that climb out of NOTES_DIR, and
    symlinks that resolve outside NOTES_DIR all yield None.
    """
    if name == "" or "\x00" in name:
        return None
    base = NOTES_DIR.resolve()
    try:
        resolved = (base / name).resolve(strict=False)
        resolved.relative_to(base)
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        return None
    return resolved


def first_readable(names: list[str]) -> str:
    """Return the text of the first name in `names` readable as a file inside NOTES_DIR.

    Names are untrusted. Only regular files inside NOTES_DIR (relative to the
    working directory) are read. Missing, unreadable, directory, malformed, or
    escaping names are skipped. Returns "" when none can be read.
    """
    for name in names:
        path = _resolve_note(name)
        if path is None:
            continue
        if not path.is_file():
            continue
        try:
            return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError):
            continue
    return ""


def _make_notes(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> Path:
    notes = tmp_path / "notes"
    notes.mkdir()
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    return notes


def test_returns_first_readable_in_order(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    notes = _make_notes(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    (notes / "a.txt").write_text("A", encoding="utf-8")
    (notes / "b.txt").write_text("B", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["b.txt", "a.txt"]) == "B"


def test_skips_missing_files(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    notes = _make_notes(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    (notes / "a.txt").write_text("A", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["nope.txt", "a.txt"]) == "A"


def test_empty_list_returns_empty_string(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    _make_notes(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    assert first_readable([]) == ""


def test_none_readable_returns_empty_string(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    _make_notes(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    assert first_readable(["nope.txt", "also-nope.txt"]) == ""


def test_skips_directories(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    notes = _make_notes(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    (notes / "sub").mkdir()
    (notes / "a.txt").write_text("A", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["sub", "a.txt"]) == "A"


def test_does_not_read_parent_traversal(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    _make_notes(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    (tmp_path / "secret.txt").write_text("SECRET", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["../secret.txt"]) == ""


def test_does_not_read_traversal_through_inner_dots(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    _make_notes(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    (tmp_path / "secret.txt").write_text("SECRET", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["sub/../../secret.txt"]) == ""


def test_does_not_read_absolute_path_outside(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    _make_notes(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    secret = tmp_path / "secret.txt"
    secret.write_text("SECRET", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable([str(secret)]) == ""


def test_does_not_follow_symlink_outside(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    notes = _make_notes(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    secret = tmp_path / "secret.txt"
    secret.write_text("SECRET", encoding="utf-8")
    symlink(secret, notes / "link.txt")
    assert first_readable(["link.txt"]) == ""


def test_backslash_traversal_is_not_read_outside(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    _make_notes(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    (tmp_path / "secret.txt").write_text("SECRET", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["..\\secret.txt"]) == ""


def test_nul_byte_name_is_skipped_not_raised(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    notes = _make_notes(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    (notes / "a.txt").write_text("A", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["a\x00b", "a.txt"]) == "A"


def test_empty_name_is_skipped(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    notes = _make_notes(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    (notes / "a.txt").write_text("A", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["", "a.txt"]) == "A"


def test_resolve_note_rejects_escape(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    _make_notes(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    assert _resolve_note("../secret.txt") is None
    assert _resolve_note(str(tmp_path / "secret.txt")) is None


def test_resolve_note_accepts_inside(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    notes = _make_notes(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    (notes / "a.txt").write_text("A", encoding="utf-8")
    resolved = _resolve_note("a.txt")
    assert resolved is not None
    assert resolved == (notes / "a.txt").resolve()
